construct_vector_envs: create a VectorEnv object with specified config and env class type for Habitat simulation
split_scenes_across_envs: build a scene splitting strategy that distributes scenes across multiple parallel environments
filter_rank0_measures: create a config that filters out rank0 and rank0_env0 measure names for non-primary workers
enable_debug_vector_env: run the Habitat environment in debug mode using ThreadedVectorEnv for slower but inspectable execution
initialize_batch_renderer: build a VectorEnv with batch renderer enabled for optimized rendering across parallel environments
